title: Head Start got her out of homelessness. Trump proposal threatens that help for others
summary: A Trump administration proposal would change access to Head Start for children experiencing homelessness and the kind of care they would receive if they do get in.
contentText:
A Trump administration proposal would change access to Head Start for children experiencing homelessness and the kind of care they would receive if they do get in.
